titles.title: Colonel Gary LaGrange AgVets Act of 2026
Colonel Gary LaGrange AgVets Act of 2026

A bill to amend the Agricultural Research, Extension, and Education Reform Act of 1998 to direct the Secretary of Agriculture to establish a program under which the Secretary will award competitive grants to eligible entities for the purpose of establishing and enhancing farming and ranching opportunities for veterans.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
